expression.original: The field can now observe its own accepted-state sequence: the chronicle projection reconstructs F_0 -> F_1 -> F_2 from first-parent history and derives each transition (appearances, status changes, origin confirmations, and any removals). At F_2 the sequence reads: F_0 (38 elements, 7 unconfirmed) -> F_1 (+DIM-0001, first independent acceptance) -> F_2 (+OBS-0001, 7 confirmations arrive, unconfirmed falls from 8 to 1).
expression.elaboration: Self-reference declared, not hidden: this observation is produced by a projection of the very history it will enter. Once accepted, it becomes part of the next state the chronicle displays - the loop 'dx/dt = F(x, V); dV/dt = G(x, V)' (doc Q1 §5) applied to the field itself. The chronicle also watches for append-preservation violations (removals) and displays them rather than suppressing them, per the Lean invariant history_preserved whose guarantee holds only if transitions remain append-only in practice.
expression.unresolved_nuance: The chronicle reads first-parent history only; squash or rebase merges would change what counts as an accepted state. The projection inherits git's geometry as measurement geometry (REL-0028).
